title: Self-Pay Visit Package Terms — Transferring Unused Visits
content:
**Transfer of unused visits.** Unused visits on a Self-Pay Visit Package are transferred only from an active package where the tier allows transfers, only to a patient who is in the holder's permitted relationship for the tier, only when at least the tier's minimum unused visits remain, and at most the tier's number of transfers per package. The transfer is the holder's own decision.

**Relationships**

- *Immediate family:* a spouse, parent, child or sibling of the holder.
- *Household:* anyone at the same mailing address on file as the holder.

**Movement of the visits.** The clause that all remaining visits move together is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current basis for the visits that move. The visits transferred are credited to an active package the recipient holds and keep the giving package's expiry date.

**Conditions checklist**

| Condition | Read from |
|---|---|
| Giving package in active status | the giving package's own record |
| Tier allows transfers | the tier's sharing terms |
| Recipient within the permitted relationship | spouse, parent, child or sibling; or the same mailing address on file |
| Unused visits at least the tier's minimum | the giving package |
| Transfers already made fewer than the tier's limit | the giving package's history |

*Hypothetical case:* on a tier whose permitted relationship is immediate family, a holder's sibling may receive visits; a friend sharing the holder's address may not, because that tier's relationship is immediate family and not household.
